note: Both sets are nearly identical, containing the same significant errors (misreads of graph values, duplicates, and conflicting claims for the same conditions). Set A includes one additional claim (`chord | 5.7 m` at `r/R = 0.25`) which appears consistent with the graph in Figure 2-4(a), whereas Set B omits this data point. Since both sets share the same flaws but A provides slightly more coverage without adding errors, A is marginally better.
remarks: Both sets suffer from high noise, including multiple duplicate claims (e.g., prebend at 0.0 and 1.0) and conflicting values for the same condition (e.g., twist at 0.0 has 14, 15, and 15.5 deg). The extraction logic appears to sample points but lacks consistency in reading values accurately from the plots.
